query: I spent this morning trying the new matcha croissant at the little bakery down the street from my hotel, it had this perfect crispy crust and the matcha filling wasn’t too sweet at all, I even bought a second one to save for later. I also spent 20 minutes watching a street performer juggle flaming batons while I waited for my coffee, they were so good I tipped them five euros. Oh right, I’m having some trouble with my phone service right now. I realized airplane mode is turned on, my network preference setting isn’t working right, my data mode is off, and I’m currently abroad with roaming turned off so I can’t get any connection at all, can you help me fix this?
